B.), all-caps words, and mid-text capitalized proper names or titles for specific referents (James, President, Whitfield, Springfield, Paris) as well as rare capitalized common nouns (Planetarium, Mill), whose burst tends to peak one or two tokens after the noun rather than on it. It stays below 0.04 on ordinary mid-sentence English, on the same names in lowercase (james, president, paris), and on frequent capitalized words and nouns in normal flow (On, Sunday, Museum, Committee).
